records.claim_text: NOAA alert 'Special Weather Statement' for Henry; Bureau.

source_metadata.noaa_description:
At 918 AM CST, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from 6 miles west of Hooppole to Atkinson. Movement
was east at 25 mph.

HAZARD...Winds in excess of 40 mph and penny size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could cause minor tree limb damage and blow
around unsecured objects. Minor damage to outdoor objects
is possible.

Locations impacted include...
Walnut, Atkinson, Annawan, Hooppole, Yorktown, Manlius, New Bedford,
Thomas, and Normandy.

This includes Interstate 80 in Illinois between mile markers 23 and
36, near mile marker 42, and between mile markers 44 and 52.
source_metadata.noaa_instruction: If outdoors, consider seeking shelter inside a building.
